title: Energy baseline validity in continuous process industries — scoping review package
description: Records, instruments, code and derived results of a scoping review of energy performance indicator (EnPI) and energy baseline (EnB) models, with detailed charting of studies in pre-registered continuous-process sectors. Includes screening and eligibility records, two independent model-assisted extractions of Corpus A and their reconciliation, the Corpus B extraction records, the September 2026 model re-reading, and the human checks executed in October 2026 under the amendment deposited on OSF. Full texts of the reviewed publications and publisher abstracts are not included. Protocol: 10.17605/OSF.IO/TDW6C.
